name: Data.hasRigidLabels_spaceW
summary: Apply occurringLabels_subsingleton with L the theta lift of W_j to the definite V_j for the trivial twist: it is injective, makes eigenforms spherical off the level, and has parahoric type at x with psi the inverse tame part and no further characters.

steps.claim: For an eigensystem p and a chosen place x, apply occurringLabels_subsingleton to V = spaceW(D, j) with L the theta lift auxLift(D, 1, j) of forms on W_j to algebraic forms on V_j (trivial twist).
steps.lean:
j) := fun p x ↦ D.occurringLabels_subsingleton _ (D.auxLift_injective .one) (fun _ h _ a ↦
  D.lifts_auxLift _ h _ a.1 (by simp_all [auxPair, levelPlaces, IsSplitOffLevel]; tauto)) x 1 _
  (fun _ ↦ by simpa [auxLift_principalRep] using! D.hasParahoricType_chosenGLRep fun _ ↦ rfl)
  (fun _ ↦ by lia) (by simpa using! D.omega_zpow_mul_pow_eq_one _ rfl) (by simp)

steps.claim: For y in the p-part and every split place w off the chosen places, L(y) is spherical at w with an eigenvalue depending only on p (w is also off the places of the trivial twist).
steps.lean:
(fun _ h _ a ↦
  D.lifts_auxLift _ h _ a.1 (by simp_all [auxPair, levelPlaces, IsSplitOffLevel]; tauto))

steps.claim: Take the place x, the trivial family chi = 1 of further characters (one further block), and psi to be determined.

For every y, L(y) has parahoric type at x with psi = psi(O, x)^(-1) and F(g) = L(principalRep(D, W_j)(g at x) y): by hasParahoricType_chosenGLRep, as L intertwines principalRep on W_j with the action of the auxiliary pair on V_j.
steps.lean: (fun _ ↦ by simpa [auxLift_principalRep] using! D.hasParahoricType_chosenGLRep fun _ ↦ rfl)

steps.claim: chi is injective (one block); psi^(M_omega) = 1, since the tame part at the chosen place x is a power of omega_x, of order M_omega; and chi_l^(M_omega) = 1 trivially.
steps.lean: (fun _ ↦ by lia) (by simpa using! D.omega_zpow_mul_pow_eq_one _ rfl) (by simp)
